verdict.rationale: Dover documents generic interview planning and candidate scheduling with templates and calendar connections. Nothing in the evidence covers automatic scheduling of multi-interviewer panels or onsite loops, interviewer load balancing, room booking, or conflict resolution. Basic one-off scheduling is an adjacent feature, not the panel/loop automation this story requires.

support.subject: As a recruiter, multi-interviewer panels and full onsite loops schedule automatically — interviewer load balancing, room booking, and conflict resolution included
